title: Four agreements, in dollars
subtitle: City of Austin, Place-Based Enhancement Program
alt: Bar chart from a City of Austin release: Place-Based Enhancement Program agreements of up to $182,664 for Esther's Follies, up to $84,390 for Escuelita del Alma, up to $82,077 for Royal Blue Grocery, and $864,210 for nonprofit office space at Waverly North. The City says the four agreements total more than $1.2 million.
